faq.lede: Everything we get asked most often. If your question isn't here, the operations team replies the same business day.

items.q: What countries do you operate in?
items.a: We operate primarily out of Egypt and the UAE, with active corridors into Europe, North Africa, and the wider GCC. Origin reach extends globally through established partner networks — please contact us for country-specific routing.

items.q: Can you help with customs clearance only?
items.a: Yes. Although most clients engage us for the full lifecycle, standalone customs clearance and documentation handling is one of our most-requested services.

items.q: What types of goods can you handle?
items.a: Telecoms equipment, electronics, industrial infrastructure, consumer goods, and most general cargo. We confirm cargo eligibility against Egyptian standard specifications and destination regulations before quoting.

items.q: How long does shipping typically take?
items.a: Sea freight between Egypt and the UAE typically clears in 10–18 days door-to-door. Air freight runs 3–5 days. Land routes vary with origin. Every shipment is quoted with a committed delivery window.

items.q: Do I need my own import license to work with you?
items.a: No. Equinox's agency model exists specifically for businesses that don't hold their own import card or licenses. We import on your behalf using our credentials.

items.q: What's the engagement model — project or retainer?
items.a: Both. We support one-off shipments as well as long-term retainer relationships with quarterly volume commitments. Pricing is transparent on either model.

head.title: A logistical bridge for businesses without borders.
head.sub: Equinox International is a specialist agency built to move goods between continents on behalf of companies that lack the licenses, infrastructure, or appetite to manage the procedural complexity themselves.

story.title: Tramlining Regional Supply Chains: Overcoming the Regulatory Bottleneck
paragraphs: Across Egypt and the wider region, ambitious enterprises frequently encounter a critical operational bottleneck: the intricate web of import cards, regulatory licensing, customs documentation, and certificates of conformity. Navigating these bureaucratic hurdles often severely compromises supply chain agility, forcing even well-established corporations to operate at the speed of administrative red tape.

Equinox International was founded specifically to dismantle these barriers. As a fully licensed Joint Stock Company leveraging our own established import credentials, we empower clients to source, transport, and clear goods with unparalleled enterprise velocity. By partnering with us, organizations eliminate the need to construct or maintain capital-intensive, complex in-house regulatory frameworks.

For over a decade, Equinox has been the trusted trade compliance partner for market leaders in telecommunications, distribution, and infrastructure across Egypt and the UAE. We support Tier-1 enterprises whose operations depend entirely on precision, reliability, and the seamless, uninterrupted arrival of critical shipments.

sections.title: Import and export on your behalf — without a local entity.
sections.lede: EQUINOX International provides professional Importer of Record (IOR) and Exporter of Record (EOR) services that enable international companies to import or export goods without the need to establish a local legal entity. Acting as the official importer or exporter on behalf of our clients, we manage regulatory compliance, documentation, duties, and tax requirements, ensuring that shipments fully comply with local laws and international trade regulations. Our IOR / EOR solutions support companies across a wide range of sectors, including telecom, technology, medical equipment, food, electronics, oil & gas, mining, and industrial projects.

sections.title: Integrated logistics and supply chain solutions, origin to destination.
sections.lede: EQUINOX International delivers end-to-end logistics and supply chain solutions engineered to keep goods moving seamlessly from origin to final destination. structure.title: A small team is a feature, not a constraint.
paragraphs: Equinox is structured around senior generalists supported by a specialised customs clearance team. Every member of the operations group has direct industry experience — from port-side documentation through to bonded warehouse coordination.

This is deliberate. Logistics outcomes are won and lost on the experience of the person actually handling the file. A small team of career specialists consistently outperforms a large team built around process documents.
For every account, you'll work with the same logistics officer from intake through final delivery — and you'll reach the director directly when it matters.
